run_build_static_dataset: run the script to build a static voxel shape dataset with configurable examples and sidelength
run_build_static_dataset_with_dictionary: run the script with a word dictionary to build a labeled voxel dataset
run_build_static_dataset_custom_workers: run the script with custom worker count to build a voxel dataset in parallel
run_build_static_dataset_custom_transfor: run the script with shape transforms like thicker, scale, rotate, and fill
run_build_static_dataset_custom_sideleng: run the script with a custom sidelength to build voxel tensors of different sizes
